title: Smart Budgets Dedupe Fix Status Update
summary: The team confirmed the dedupe‑on‑Plaid‑transaction‑ID fix will merge on Oct 19 with a backfill on Oct 21, and a new edge case was added to the matching logic. A demo environment will be ready by Oct 27 for prospect demos, while the weekly launch email targets a 40% open rate and will include a FAQ link. The support FAQ on duplicate transactions will be completed by Friday, and all non‑critical feature work is frozen until after the Oct 29 launch.
key_points: Dedupe‑on‑Plaid‑transaction‑ID fix in review; edge case added for Capital One pending transactions; timeline moved up to Oct 19 with backfill on Oct 21.
Demo environment required for two enterprise prospect demos; target ready by Oct 27.
Weekly summary email drafted, targeting 40% open rate and will include a brief FAQ link.
Support FAQ about duplicate transactions to be ready by Friday.
Feature freeze declared: no new feature requests, categorizer enhancements and non‑essential design work paused until after Oct 29.
